items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: So that's when I started playing with them. They always called him Kit Thomas.

ctx.x: When were you working with Thomas? That was way early in your career? Yeah, it was kind of early in my career. You never worked in his band in later years?

No. You see, well, Kit Thomas and the guy they called Elton, well I didn't know this until afterwards. It was Kit Thomas' band, but Elton was running the band. You see, we all started with Elton's band until they had some kind of misunderstanding, and they split. So he had to change the name from Kit Thomas to another name, you see. So that's when I started playing with them. They always called him Kit Thomas.

Morgan told me he was in the band and they had real trouble, Andrew Morgan, said he had a lot of trouble with the telephone then. Because the phone was in Elton Paredo's house, is that right? Yeah, that's what I'm talking about.
